rules.title: Security deposit capped at one month's rent; limit on move-in payments
rules.requirement: At or before the start of a tenancy, a landlord may collect only first month's rent, last month's rent, a security deposit of no more than one month's rent, and the cost of a new lock and key. The deposit must be held as required and the tenant given a statement of condition.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential leases and tenancies in Massachusetts.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Lease provisions that conflict with the section are void. A landlord who violates deposit rules forfeits the right to retain the deposit. Treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees apply for failure to deposit properly, failure to return, or use of conflicting lease terms.
rules.quoted_span: (iii) a security deposit equal to the first month's rent provided that such security deposit is deposited as required by subsection (3) and that the tenant is given the statement of condition as required by subsection (2);
rules.conflict_note: The introductory paragraph of clause (b) was amended by St. 2025, c. 9, effective August 1, 2025, to also bind agents of the lessor. The underlying deposit cap predates that amendment.

rules.title: No upfront charges to lessor or lessor's agent beyond permitted amounts
rules.requirement: Neither a landlord nor the landlord's agent may require a tenant or prospective tenant to pay them anything beyond first and last month's rent, a security deposit and lock/key cost, at or before the start of a tenancy. This effectively bars other upfront fees, such as application fees or a lessor's broker fees, paid to the lessor or agent.
rules.key_value: Only first month, last month, deposit (1 month), lock/key cost
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies in Massachusetts. Applies to payments required by the lessor or the lessor's agent from tenants or prospective tenants.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Does not apply to vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

rules.penalty: Conflicting lease provisions and waivers are void and unenforceable.

rules.conflict_note: The statute does not expressly name application or screening fees. Treating this as a bar on such fees is an interpretation of the general upfront-payment limit. The 2025 amendment extending the rule to agents took effect August 1, 2025; the prior text covered lessors only.

rules.title: Optional fee in lieu of security deposit, capped at one month's rent
rules.requirement: EOHLC may adopt regulations letting a landlord and tenant agree to a fee in lieu of a security deposit. The fee must be optional, offered to all approved applicants, and capped in total, together with any deposit paid, at one month's rent.
rules.key_value: Total fee (plus any deposit) max 1 month's rent
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential tenancies in Massachusetts where the lessor offers a fee in lieu of a security deposit under EOHLC regulations.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Operative only to the extent EOHLC has promulgated implementing regulations and the lessor elects to offer the fee.

rules.quoted_span: (C) limit the total sum of the fee or recurring payments, regardless of the duration of the lease and any extensions thereto, to an amount not to exceed 1 month's rent;
rules.conflict_note: The provision authorizes regulations. The document does not state whether EOHLC has issued them or when this provision took effect.

rules.title: Security deposit must be held in separate interest-bearing Massachusetts bank account
rules.requirement: The landlord must hold the deposit in a separate, interest-bearing account at a bank in Massachusetts, protected from the landlord's creditors. Within 30 days the landlord must give the tenant a receipt showing the bank name and location, the amount and the account number.
rules.coverage_conditions: Lessors of residential property in Massachusetts who receive a security deposit.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.penalty: Tenant is entitled to immediate return of the deposit. The lessor forfeits the right to retain the deposit, and treble damages plus 5% interest, costs and attorney's fees apply.
rules.quoted_span: (3) (a) Any security deposit received by such lessor shall be held in a separate, interest-bearing account in a bank, located within the commonwealth under such terms as will place such deposit beyond the claim of creditors of the lessor, including a foreclosing mortgagee or trustee in bankruptcy, and as will provide for its transfer to a subsequent owner of said property.

rules.title: Statement of condition required with security deposit
rules.requirement: A landlord who accepts a security deposit must give the tenant a signed written statement of the unit's condition, listing existing damage. It is due when the deposit is received or within 10 days after the tenancy begins, whichever is later. The tenant has 15 days to return it with any added damage list.
rules.coverage_conditions: Lessors of residential property in Massachusetts who accept a security deposit.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.penalty: Damage listed in the statement may not be deducted from the deposit. A deposit taken without the statement exceeds the permitted amount.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor of residential real property, or his agent, who accepts a security deposit from a tenant or prospective tenant shall, upon receipt of such security deposit, or within ten days after commencement of the tenancy, whichever is later, furnish to such tenant or prospective tenant a separate written statement of the present condition of the premises to be leased or rented.

rules.title: Annual interest on security deposits
rules.requirement: A landlord holding a deposit for a year or more must pay the tenant interest yearly from the first day of the tenancy. The rate is 5% per year or the lesser rate actually earned at the bank. The landlord must also give an annual statement, and the tenant may deduct unpaid interest from rent.
rules.key_value: 5% per year or lesser bank rate
rules.coverage_conditions: Lessors of residential property in Massachusetts holding a security deposit for one year or longer.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.penalty: Tenant may deduct unpaid interest from the next rent payment. Failure to return the deposit with interest triggers treble damages.
rules.quoted_span: (b) A lessor of residential real property who holds a security deposit pursuant to this section for a period of one year or longer from the commencement of the term of the tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of the tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year, or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held payable to the tenant at the end of each year of the tenancy.

rules.title: Receipt and interest on prepaid last month's rent
rules.requirement: A landlord who collects last month's rent in advance must give a receipt. The landlord must pay the tenant yearly interest at 5% or the lesser bank rate, starting from the first day of the tenancy.
rules.key_value: 5% per year or lesser bank rate
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential lessors in Massachusetts who collect last month's rent in advance.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.penalty: Failure to pay interest within 30 days after the tenancy ends: three times the interest owed, plus court costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
rules.quoted_span: Any lessor or his agent who receives said rent in advance for the last month of tenancy shall, beginning with the first day of tenancy, pay interest at the rate of five per cent per year or other such lesser amount of interest as has been received from the bank where the deposit has been held.

rules.title: Return of security deposit within 30 days; limited deductions
rules.requirement: The landlord must return the deposit, or the balance, within 30 days after the tenancy ends. Deductions are allowed only for unpaid rent or water charges, unpaid tax-escalation increases, and damage beyond reasonable wear and tear. Damage deductions require a sworn itemized list with written cost evidence.
rules.coverage_conditions: Lessors of residential property in Massachusetts holding a security deposit.
rules.exemptions: Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less.
rules.penalty: The lessor forfeits the right to retain any portion of the deposit. Treble damages of the deposit amount plus 5% interest, costs and reasonable attorney's fees apply.
rules.quoted_span: (4) The lessor shall, within thirty days after the termination of occupancy under a tenancy-at-will or the end of the tenancy as specified in a valid written lease agreement, return to the tenant the security deposit or any balance thereof;

rules.title: Transfer of security deposit to successor owner
rules.requirement: When a landlord transfers the property, the deposit and accrued interest must be transferred to the successor. The successor must notify the tenant in writing within 45 days and is liable for returning the deposit.
rules.coverage_conditions: Residential lessors in Massachusetts who transfer their interest in a unit for which a deposit is held, and their successors.
rules.exemptions: The successor-liability provision does not apply to municipalities acquiring title under chapter 60 or to foreclosing state- or federally-chartered financial institution mortgagees. Vacation or recreational rentals of 100 days or less are also exempt.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Depends on a transfer of ownership and the type of successor.

rules.penalty: The lessor forfeits the right to retain the deposit, and the successor assumes liability. Treble damages apply under subsection (7).
rules.quoted_span: The successor in interest shall, within forty-five days from the date of said transfer, notify the tenant who made such security deposit that such security deposit was transferred to him and that he is holding said security deposit.
